title: 第25章 仙帝之资第26章 叶汐湄天命收徒系统
slug: 我气运之子反派系统什么鬼
content_zh:
“那是什么？”
墨羽疑惑，这世界元婴还分等级？
炎曦耐心解释。
“元婴分三个等级，天道、地道、人道。”
“渡过五十四道雷劫，凝结地道元婴，而天雷合一，成就天道元婴。”
“天道元婴比寻常元婴更加强大。”
“在同等级的情况下，一个天道元婴修士，往往能与百名地道元婴对战而不落下风。”
“而且从你的天劫规模来看，已经触及到了六九天劫的极限，你所凝结的，乃是最顶尖的天道元婴！”
她越说越激动。
“小羽，你现在放到仙界都能算是中上天骄，有仙帝之资！”
墨羽轻咳一声。
这话可不兴乱说，有大因果。
“不过你也不要太过骄傲，虽然有仙帝之资，但也只有一线机会。”
“我当年，也是天道元婴，虽然不是最顶尖的，但也不赖，可即便如此，依旧连仙帝的门槛都看不到。”
虽然她话这么说，但墨羽现在毕竟一直在下界。
到了上界，肯定不止现在的潜力。
墨羽说不定最终真的能成就仙帝。
一想到这，她不禁嘴角翘得老高，一脸得意。
墨羽腹诽，明明是你更骄傲好不好。
他定了定心神。

还未结束，他还能继续突破。
他从储物戒中取出大量灵石，继续运转大焚天诀，疯狂吸收。
……
金光渐渐消散。
离得最近的苏媚儿看到墨羽的身影，松了口气。
“真是吓死了~”
她美眸流转，打量着墨羽，有些惊讶。
这小家伙，竟然毫发无伤？
要知道，即使是拥有系统的她，在金丹期时也未必能接下那等恐怖的天劫。
而墨羽居然做到了。
看来，多出去走走，确实有好处，说不定就能遇到什么天大的机缘。
大师姐洛素心就非常喜欢在外面游玩。
而她正好也是最强的。
苏媚儿正要上前，却发现墨羽居然还在突破！
生气，非常生气！
这个臭弟弟，真是太不让人省心了！
她一定要找个机会，好好教训他一顿。
圣虚子和众长老准备进山给墨羽收尸。
content_en:
"What's that?"
Mo Yu was confused, is there still levels in this world for Yuanying?
Yan Xi explained patiently.
"The Nascent Soul is divided into three levels, the heavenly realm, the earthly realm, and the human realm."
"Surviving fifty-four thunder tribulations, the earth's Nascent Soul condensed, and the heavenly thunder merged into one, creating the Heaven's Nascent Soul."
"Tiandao Yuanying is more powerful than ordinary Yuanying."
"At the same level, a heavenly Nascent Soul cultivator can often fight against hundreds of Earthly Nascent Souls without falling behind."
"And judging from the scale of your heavenly tribulation, it has reached the limit of six or nine heavenly tribulations. What you have condensed is the top Tiandao Nascent Soul!"
The more she talked, the more excited she became.
"Xiao Yu, you can be regarded as a genius in the immortal world now, and you have the qualifications of an immortal emperor!"
Mo Yu coughed lightly.
This is not something to be said casually, it has great cause and effect.
"But don't be too proud. Although you have the qualifications of an Immortal Emperor, you only have a slim chance."
"Back then, I was also a Nascent Soul of Heavenly Dao. Although I was not the top, I was not bad either. But even so, I still couldn't even see the threshold of the Immortal Emperor."
Although she said so, Mo Yu has been in the lower realm after all.
When it reaches the upper realm, it will definitely have more than its current potential.
Mo Yu might actually become an Immortal Emperor in the end.
When she thought of this, she couldn't help but raise the corners of her mouth, looking proud.
Mo Yu cursed, you are obviously the prouder, okay?
He composed himself.
It's not over yet, he can continue to make breakthroughs.
He took out a large number of spiritual stones from the storage ring and continued to run the Great Burning Heaven Technique, absorbing them like crazy.
…
The golden light gradually dissipated.
Su Meier, who was the closest, breathed a sigh of relief when she saw Mo Yu's figure.
"It's really scary~"
Her beautiful eyes moved as she looked at Mo Yu, a little surprised.
This little guy was unscathed?
You know, even if she has the system, she may not be able to withstand such horrific catastrophes when she is in the golden elixir stage.
And Mo Yu actually did it.
It seems that there are indeed benefits to going out more, and you might encounter some great opportunities.
Senior sister Luo Suxin likes to play outside very much.
And she also happens to be the strongest.
Su Meier was about to step forward, but found that Mo Yu was still breaking through!
Angry, very angry!
This stinky brother is so annoying!
She must find an opportunity to teach him a lesson.
Sheng Xuzi and the elders were preparing to go into the mountain to collect Mo Yu's body.
